description: Search the 150-text canonical corpus of classical botanical and medical traditions. Returns the source texts behind the provenance records: title, author, era, tradition or pillar, synopsis, a defining quoted line, and topic domains. Use this to locate the manuscript a claim originates in.

limit.description: Maximum number of canon entries to return.

query.description: Text title, author, tradition, pillar or topic, e.g. 'Charaka', 'Tibetan', 'Pulse' or 'Nighantu'.

name: search_canon
title: Search the canonical corpus
